description: Term list of the Study 2 unsealing audit (pilot-tasks.md §1: a step never names a layer, a port, an interface or a pattern). Tooling, not a pre-registration. Committed before the tool was written. Matching is case-insensitive and whole-word; a multi-word term also matches with hyphens, underscores or no separator between its words; a plural (s, es, y to ies) matches its singular. A hit inside an allow phrase is ignored; a hit inside a longer hit is folded into it.
